patches.reason: Tailwind shadow utilities compile to literal offsets, so elevation cannot reach through a variable. Animating without a reduced-motion guard ignores the user's stated preference.

limitations: Control heights stay on the upstream scale; Balsa density is not a Tailwind grid unit.
Type scale stays on the upstream scale; Balsa defines no numeric type scale.
The Glass material is not applied; material direction is a composition decision.
